ChildSnapshot.description: Copied linked-operation summary; availability is explicit.

available.description: Actual retained child summary, never the parent's copied metrics.

finished_at.description: Actual owner completion time, when known.

id.description: Diagnostic identity of the associated operation.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

observed_at.description: Actual time this relationship was first observed in the parent clock.

outcome.description: Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable.

relationship.description: Producer-declared relationship, independent of interval overlap.

CounterInterval.description: Retained additive interval, copied for passive narrower-window reads.

delta.description: Exact retained delta; absence is arithmetic overflow.

first_ns.description: Actual first source timestamp in process-clock nanoseconds.

last_ns.description: Actual last source timestamp, not a fabricated bucket boundary.

reset.description: Source generation/reset boundary affected this interval.

CounterWindow.description: Bounded additive history; it cannot be reconstructed from arbitrary point samples.

duration.description: Duration intervals have open intersection boundaries; counts have checkpoint boundaries.

intervals.description: Retained second intervals, bounded by the same low-owner retention.

observed.description: At least one actual counter interval has been observed, even if none intersects this window.

partial.description: Retained updates are incomplete independently of requested interval boundaries.

Coverage.description: Independent coverage dimensions; loss is not hidden by otherwise available values.

available.description: Whether copied evidence is available at this read boundary.

counter_overflow.description: An exact counter exceeded its fixed-width representation.

curtailed.description: Collection or access refused observations; inspect the independent loss counts.

dropped_detail.description: Old detail events displaced by the bounded rolling ring.

dropped_updates.description: Producer updates lost to contention or attempted after termination.

enabled.description: Whether collection was requested; disabled is absent coverage.

interrupted.description: The owner guard ended without an explicit terminal explanation.

refused_items.description: Items refused by catalogue, field or collection bounds.

sampled.description: Recent aggregates or detail have reduced temporal/detail resolution.

stale.description: The active operation has no sufficiently fresh published checkpoint.

phase.description: Actual phase lifecycle facts when this detail came from a phase owner.

value.description: Copied value; this event never supplies scientific permission.

EvidenceRef.description: Exact observed location supporting an explanatory statement.

generation.description: Metric generation, if this is a metric reference.

metric.description: Producer metric name, or absent for an operation/phase fact.

observed_at.description: Actual checkpoint time; absence never means now.

operation.description: Actual diagnostic operation, including its process instance.

partial.description: Evidence has loss, reset or bounded temporal/detail resolution.

value.description: The referenced value retains unavailable and nonfinite categories.

InspectionRequest.description: Request for copied diagnostics only; it cannot request scientific work or result admission.

include_related.description: Copy bounded directly related operations; deeper navigation selects their exact IDs.

operation.description: Exact operation selected by its diagnostic process instance and sequence.

related_limit.description: Maximum directly related snapshots; effective ceiling is 32.

window.description: Requested recent interval, clamped to observed operation lifetime.

InspectionTransport.description: Checkpoint transport availability, distinct from producer freshness and scientific outcomes.

checkpoint.description: Actual file read, absent for an in-memory read.

clock_uncertainty_nanoseconds.description: Cross-process clocks are not an atomic observation; alignment may be unavailable.

failure.description: Optional writer or transport failure; it never becomes numerical failure.

partial.description: Required operation or relationship was absent/curtailed/stale in transport.

process.description: Actual process attachment locator, if supplied by the source.

published_unix_micros.description: Optional publisher timestamp; it is not native fact freshness.

MetricSnapshot.description: Latest and cumulative facts remain available after recent detail has rolled over.

counter_window.description: Retained additive intervals for passive remote window selection; absent for gauges.

cumulative.description: Observed additive work since operation start; nonadditive fields are unavailable.

cumulative_partial.description: The additive subtotal excludes an absolute baseline or has lost updates.

generation.description: Producer-declared generation of an absolute counter.

history.description: Time-coalesced actual checkpoint values, with an optional immediate predecessor.

history_dropped.description: Checkpoints or older retained slots lost specifically to history budget refusal.

history_partial.description: History coalesces detail, crosses an interval boundary, has gaps or lost observations.

latest.description: Latest published value, retaining explicit absence and nonfinite categories.

observed_at.description: Actual monotonic producer timestamp of the latest published observation.

recent.description: Sum of retained aggregates overlapping the request; partial values may include boundary work.

recent_observed_start.description: Actual earliest included aggregate timestamp, including any overlapping boundary portion.

recent_partial.description: Included aggregates cross the requested boundary, contain resets or have observation loss.

resets.description: Detected generation changes or backwards absolute-counter samples.

OperationId.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

OperationSnapshot.description: A bounded independent read. Overlapping child times must not be added as exclusive time.

children.description: Bounded linked-operation summaries, with explicit unavailable attribution.

coverage.description: Independent availability, freshness and loss facts.

detail.description: Bounded actual-time detail prefix within the requested interval.

detail_partial.description: Detail events were displaced or updates were lost; aggregate coverage is separate.

finished_at.description: Actual owner completion time, when known.

id.description: Diagnostic identity of the associated operation.

interval_end.description: End of that lifetime intersection; may equal its start.

interval_partial.description: Requested observations exceed retention or have update loss.

interval_start.description: Start of the requested interval intersected with operation lifetime.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

metrics.description: Bounded producer-owned facts; child facts are never summed implicitly.

observed_at.description: Actual monotonic producer timestamp of the latest published observation.

outcome.description: Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable.

phases.description: Independently active phase scopes at the last retained checkpoint.

read_at.description: Monotonic time at which this read was requested.

requested_interval.description: Caller-requested lookback, anchored at read time.

stale_after.description: Owner-selected freshness threshold; passive transport cannot replace this policy.

Phase.description: One independently active copied phase scope.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

token.description: Unique active-phase token; phase destruction removes only this token.

PhaseTransition.description: Actual phase entry/exit facts, retaining token and exact timestamps for optional export.

finished_at.description: Actual exit when observed; missing means an entry, not a completed interval.

started_at.description: Actual phase start, not export or read time.

token.description: Independently owned phase token within this operation.

PointSample.description: First and last checkpoint values in one observed second; intermediate detail is coalesced.

first_generation.description: Generation of the first value; compare across generations only when the owner permits it.

first_observed_at.description: Actual first observation timestamp, not a fabricated bucket boundary.

first_value.description: First value, retaining exact integer, absence and nonfinite meanings.

last_observed_at.description: Actual latest observation timestamp in this second.

nonfinite.description: At least one coalesced observation was nonfinite, even if the latest became finite.

predecessor.description: This actual checkpoint is the immediate second preceding the requested interval.

reset.description: At least one counter reset or generation transition occurred in this sample.

samples.description: Number of actual observations coalesced into this sample.

unavailable.description: At least one coalesced observation was unavailable, even if the latest became available.

value.description: Latest value in the second, independent of additive work aggregates.

ProcessLocator.description: Actual process locator. PID reuse must be checked before attaching an optional sampler.

executable.description: Current executable path for display/symbol discovery, not a content proof.

start_ticks.description: Linux process start ticks; absence does not authorize attachment.

bytes.description: Copied opaque source-owned identity or reference bytes.

Statement.description: A bounded source-linked statement. Consumers render it; they do not reinterpret it.

code.description: Stable interpretation code, not a severity or convergence score.

kind.description: Evidence strength, never an inferred numerical outcome.

message.description: Plain explanation of the observed meaning and its limits.

next.description: Discriminating optional observations; none are executed by inspection.

Value.description: A value and its availability are inseparable.

oneOf.description: Explicit absence with a bounded explanation.

description: One typed interpretation shared by Rust, generated Python and CLI consumers.

omitted.description: Statements or requested children omitted by response bounds.

operation.description: Exact selected operation, absent when unavailable/evicted rather than invented complete.

related.description: Bounded directly related observations, with their independent clocks and outcomes.

statements.description: Established explanations, hypotheses and their source-linked next observations.
